encounters.name: Act I - Ch 1: Escalator Press Confrontation
encounters.description: Skeptical cable news anchors and K-Street retainer lobbyists attempt to block the Trump Tower press conference!

encounters.name: Act I - Ch 2: The Primary Debate Arena
encounters.description: Low-Energy Dynasty rivals and focus-grouped Super PAC strategists attempt to ambush the debate podium!

encounters.name: Act I (Track A): Tan Suit & Dijon Exhibition
encounters.description: Barry Teleprompter steps onto the stage in his August 2014 summer tan suit, armed with a Dijon mustard burger and a mic-drop!

encounters.name: Act I Finale (Track A): The Chappaqua Server Sovereign
encounters.description: Hill-Rod deploys BleachBit cloth wipes, Purse Hot Sauce, and Pokémon Go-To-The-Polls on Election Night 2016!

encounters.name: Act I (Track B): Between Two Potted Ferns
encounters.description: Zach Two-Ferns rolls a rival campaign commercial mid-interview while weaponized potted ferns close in!

encounters.name: Act I Finale (Track B): Golden Podium Showdown
encounters.description: Commander America commands the stage with Accordion Hands, Diet Coke Valet Buttons, and Tic-Tac Bus counter-strikes!

encounters.name: Act II (Track A) - Ch 1: Crowd-Size Spin & The 11-Day Mooch
encounters.description: Cable News Aerial Spin Crew and The 11-Day Mooch tornado collide with Spicy Sean's podium!

encounters.name: Act II Finale (Track A): Nancy Palooza & The Sub-Zero Vault
encounters.description: Nancy Palooza unleashes 45-degree sideways seal claps, pre-scored SOTU speech rips, and twin $24,000 Sub-Zero ice cream freezers!

encounters.name: Act II (Track A) - Ch 3: Hurricane Sharpie & 15 Flushes
encounters.description: NOAA Weather-Map Fact-Checkers and Low-Flow Plumbing Inspectors challenge the Alabama Sharpie bubble and Bounty free-throws!

encounters.name: Act II (Track B) - Ch 1: White House Bushes & Neon Salsa
encounters.description: Spicy Sean leaps out of the White House hedges in his neon-green Dancing with the Stars ruffled shirt alongside The 11-Day Mooch!

encounters.name: Act II (Track B) - Ch 4: Wizard Kash & The Nunes Scroll
encounters.description: Kash Subpoena unrolls his 4-page FISA scroll while hawking his $19.99 illustrated children's book, The Plot Against the King!

encounters.name: Act II Finale (Track B): Four Seasons Total Landscaping
encounters.description: Wedged between a crematorium and Fantasy Island Adult Books, Rudy Ghoul drips hair dye down both cheeks beside Commander America!

encounters.name: Act III (Track A) - Ch 1: Windy Stairs & Toe-Cage Bike
encounters.description: Andrews Air Force Base wind gusts and a stationary Rehoboth Beach Trek bicycle with metal pedal toe-cages block the tarmac!

encounters.name: Act III (Track A) - Ch 3: Bathroom Chandeliers & Corvette Boxes
encounters.description: Subpoena Archivists inspect the Mar-a-Lago bathroom chandelier bankers boxes while ignoring the 1967 Corvette garage!

encounters.name: Act III Finale (Track A): Baskin-Robbins Waffle Cone Showdown
encounters.description: Joe Naptime licks a double-scoop chocolate chip waffle cone at Baskin-Robbins while reading 'End of quote, repeat the line' off the teleprompter!

encounters.name: Act III (Track B) - Ch 1: Corn Pop & The Toe-Cage Bicycle
encounters.description: Corn Pop ('a bad dude who ran a bunch of bad boys') bangs rusty razors in a rainwater barrel beside a treacherous toe-cage bicycle!

encounters.name: Act III (Track B) - Ch 3: Foghorn Kennedy's Oxford Drawl
encounters.description: Senator Foghorn Kennedy hides an Oxford First-Class degree behind folksy one-liners while asking judicial nominees about Article V!

encounters.name: Act III Finale (Track B): 215-Pound Mugshot & Bathroom Chandelier
encounters.description: Commander America flashes his 'Never Surrender' Fulton County mugshot beside a gilded Mar-a-Lago bathroom chandelier stacked with bankers boxes!

encounters.name: Act IV - Ch 1: Archivist Phantoms
encounters.description: Bureau Archivist Phantoms and unauthorized redaction officers attempt to shred the declassified FISA memos!

encounters.name: Act IV (Track A) - Ch 1: 'Whatever Makes Sense' Donuts & Swiss Cheese
encounters.description: JD Pants joins the party at Holt's Sweet Shoppe as an unimpressed bakery counter and a Philly Swiss-cheese purist attack!

encounters.name: Act IV (Track B) - Ch 1: Coconut Context & Venn Circles
encounters.description: Kamala Coconut unleashes overlapping Venn diagrams and yellow school buses against skeptical pundits!

encounters.name: Act IV (Track B) - Ch 2: JD Pants & 'Whatever Makes Sense'
encounters.description: JD Pants asks 'How long have you worked here? Okay, good' while hurling sprinkle donuts and CBS fact-check rules!

encounters.name: Act IV (Track B) - Ch 4: 'Concepts of a Plan' & 'People on TV'
encounters.description: On the Philadelphia debate stage, Commander America unveils 'Concepts of a Plan' and 'I saw it on television!'

encounters.name: Act IV Finale (Track B): Drive-Thru Fry Basket & Garbage Vest
encounters.description: Commander America leans out a closed-set McDonald's drive-thru window in a fry apron and neon-orange garbage truck vest beside JD Pants!

encounters.name: Act V (Track A) - Ch 1: Mid-Air Star-Jump & Porcelain Sink
encounters.description: Musk-X leaps into an X-shape mid-air with a porcelain bathroom sink while a shattered-window Cybertruck and SEC $420 auditor attack!

encounters.name: Act V (Track A) - Ch 2: Hulkster Shirt-Rip & DOGE Audit
encounters.description: Hulkster 24-Pythons rips his shirt in half as the Shiba Inu DOGE commission audits an Omnibus Pork-Barrel Golem!

encounters.name: Act V (Track A) - Ch 3: Mayor Swagger & Turkish Lie-Flat Suites
encounters.description: Mayor Swagger pulls contraband out of a baby doll's head while sipping rat-free table water in a Turkish Airlines suite!

encounters.name: Act V Grand Finale (Track A): Mr. Cardamom & The All-Star Relay
encounters.description: Zohran Cardamom ('Mr. Cardamom') flips sizzling chapatis alongside Kamala Coconut's Venn Diagrams and Joe Naptime's Double-Scoop Cone!

encounters.name: Act V (Track B) - Ch 1: 'Nani' Chapati Truck & Rent Freeze
encounters.description: Zohran Cardamom ('Mr. Cardamom') and Mayor Swagger defend the Astoria chapati truck against Rent-Board Lobbyists!

encounters.name: Act V (Track B) - Ch 2: 6-Digit Passcodes & Chilean Sea Bass
encounters.description: Subpoena Passcode Crackers and Rat-Ticket Inspectors ambush Mayor Swagger outside Osteria La Baia!

encounters.name: Act V (Track B) - Ch 3: Mid-Air 'X' Star-Jump & Porcelain Sink
encounters.description: Musk-X leaps into an X-shape mid-air exposing four inches of midriff while hurling a porcelain bathroom sink!

encounters.name: Act V (Track B) - Ch 4: Donuts, Wizard Books & Oxford Drawls
encounters.description: JD Pants, Wizard Kash, and Senator Foghorn Kennedy defend the Shiba Inu DOGE hearing room!

encounters.name: Act V Grand Finale (Track B): Golden Podium & Dark Gothic MAGA
encounters.description: Zohran Cardamom and Mayor Swagger clash with Commander America, Musk-X's Mid-Air Star-Jump, and the Diet Coke Valet Button!

encounters.name: Act VI - Ch 3: The Electric School Bus Mire
encounters.description: A Stranded Battery Golem and Federal Green Mandate Drones attempt to siphon the party's energy into non-existent chargers!

encounters.name: Act VI: The Word-Salad Wasteland
encounters.description: Kamala the Unburdened traps the hero in endless overlapping Venn diagrams and circular speeches!
